scopeAssessment.capability: Manage account GST invoice-recipient profile and reuse it in later carts
scopeAssessment.reason: Prevents repeated recipient input in the launch checkout journey while retaining correct invoice attribution.
scopeAssessment.reuse: Reuse BuyV2GstInvoiceController, existing GST sheet and BuyV2GstInvoiceProfileStore, with the existing shared account profile surface. No separate GST screen/store hierarchy unless demonstrated necessary.
dependencyOrder: Coordinate shared Profile owner and GST account contract before implementation selection.
Implement and locally qualify frontend with controlled account-store fixtures.
Implement authorized account-backed persistence during backend phase, then qualify real account and Redmi journeys.
exclusions: No backend implementation, provisioning or deployment now.
No change to tax computation, historical invoices or seller GST ownership.
No account creation or new APK in this frontend implementation.

backendBusinessLogic.observedGap: Only _BuyV2DeviceReviewGstInvoiceProfileStore implementation found in runtime lib; it holds an in-memory snapshot under device-review-session scope. It is not account persistence.
requirements: Bind GSTIN, legal name, billing address and chosen default recipient profile to the authenticated account; enforce owner-only reads and writes server-side.
Reuse the authoritative account/profile store and versioned data contract after coordination; do not provision a separate database or duplicate catalogue.
Persist explicit add/edit/remove operations and default choice; restore across app restart and same-account re-login, with cross-device verification when a backend is available.
Clear account-scoped cache and ignore stale in-flight responses on sign-out/account switch; never expose one account GST details to another.
Handle read/save failure, unavailable service, retries and concurrent edits truthfully; never report account-saved until persisted and never treat a failed read as no profile.
Snapshot applicable recipient details into new order/invoice contracts at authoritative creation; later profile edits must not rewrite historical invoices.
Honor account deletion and applicable profile retention policy; do not put GSTIN/address into diagnostics.
backendBusinessLogic.activation: Pending separately authorized backend phase and shared account/Store contract coordination. Frontend fixture passes cannot close this dependency.
